title: WaterColor "Our Happy Place" 12 Blazing Star Drive
h1: WaterColor "Our Happy Place" 12 Blazing Star Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:-Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Steps Away from the Dragonfly Community Pool- 6-Passenger low speed vehicle golf cart- 5 adult bikes- Bonus room - Gas grill- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- Parking for 2 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the WaterColor Beach Club. It features a main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Discover Our Happy Place, a delightful 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom WaterColor home that sleeps up to 10 guests. Enjoy cheerful days relaxing on the porch or strolling to the Dragonfly Pool, only a short 4-minute stroll. Fun is always on the itinerary with access to WaterColor’s numerous amenities, including Camp WaterColor’s lazy river and WaterColor Beach Club.An inviting screened-in porch, outfitted with comfortable Adirondack seating, inspires relaxation the moment guests arrive at this 2-story home. Picture quiet mornings sipping coffee in the gentle breeze from the overhead fan. Inside, classic wainscoting and rich hardwood floors pair with coastal chic decor. Sink into the soft sofa and armchairs to watch TV or curl up with a book. An elegant 6-person table encourages group meals, while the neighboring built-in desk is perfect for guests who need to mix work with leisure. Continue into the bright, open kitchen, where marble countertops and high-end appliances invite inner chefs to indulge. The island doubles as a 4-stool breakfast bar for quick bites or entertaining friends and family while prepping dinner. The beautiful primary bedroom’s king bed and private bathroom provide a serene sanctuary for the night. A laundry closet with a side-by-side washer and dryer adds convenience. Outside, guests will find a grill for juicy burgers and Summer barbecues.On the second level, a light-filled seating area offers kids a space of their own to play or watch TV. Rest peacefully in the well-appointed primary bedroom, which boasts a king bed, private bathroom, and a spacious covered porch with seating. The 2 lovely guest bedrooms feature a king and queen bed, respectively. Guests who don’t mind sharing space can take advantage of the charming bunk room with 1 twin-over-twin bunk bed.Our Happy Place in WaterColor promises an enchanting setting for coastal fun and cherished memories. Parking for 2 vehicles, alongside 5 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle, makes it easy to explore nearby 30A neighborhoods, including Seaside and Seagrove Beach. For beach access, choose between the access atWaterColor Beach Club or the access located on Goldenrod Circle past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Living Area: Living Room*Garage is not for guest use.
